# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: The relevant seal inscription form is 日 sun/day + an element# combining 辵 movement and 夂 leg/foot pointing downward (→ drop) → sun dropping to the western horizon → *retreat*; *withdraw* → *keep at a distance*; *shrink* (from) → *resign*; *decline*; *refuse*; *reject*; *refrain*; *drive off/out* (← keep at a distance). Later, the 日 and 夂 elements were altered to 艮 (adhere), though the bottom-right portion now exhibits a slight distinction.
The right-hand element# is a variant of 奏 offer. 送 adds 辵 movement → *send* offerings → *send/see off*; *give*; *transport*.
遣也。从辵，㑞省。
As per 舌# (chisel-like implement in motion) + 辵 movement → active (not sluggish) movement → *fast*; *quick*.
疾也。从辵𠯑聲。讀與括同。
As per 兆# (split) + 辵 movement → split away in evasion → *evade*; *run away*; *flee*; *escape* → *set free*. Also, *miss*, *miss an opportunity*, *fail to catch* and *shirk*.
亾也。从辵兆聲。
As per 后# (keep out of sight) + 辵 movement → meet a person normally kept from one's sight → *meet* (unexpectedly).
邂逅也。从辵后聲。
屰# reverse + 辵 movement → *reverse*; *go against*; *invert*; *opposite*; *upside-down*; *inside-out*; *defy*; *disobey*; (go to) *meet*; *in advance*.
迎也。从辵屰聲。關東曰逆，關西曰迎。
As per 甫# (spread) + 辵 movement → *evade capture* (← spread out to avoid captors) → *skip out on a debt* → *unpaid debt*.
亾也。从辵甫聲。
As per 卣# (long) + 辵 movement → long path (leading to happiness/contentment; compare 迪) → *relaxed*; *happy*.
As per 肖# (resemble in miniature) + 辵 movement → take small steps in strolling → *stroll*; *ramble*; *saunter*; *wander*.
逍遥，猶翱翔也。从辵肖聲。
迫也。从辵酉聲。

秀# surpass + 辵 movement → *penetrate*/*pass through* in surpassing → *create a gap/space* → *opening* (← gap) → *look through* (← look through a gap) → *transparency* (← be able to look/see through). Also, *thin* (out), *empty out* and *be free/unoccupied*, as well as *watermark* (← mark made visible by transparency).
跳也。過也。从辵秀聲。

豕 pig/boar + 辵# movement → *chase* down a wild pig/boar one careful step at a time, finally tightening a circle about it (compare 狩 and 獸) → *pursue* → *drive off* → *one by one*; *one after another* (← one step at a time).
追也。从辵，从豚省。
As per 求# (wrap) + 辵 movement (→ action indicator) → (figuratively/actually) wrap about oneself in gathering → *gather/assemble*. Also, *partner* (among others in a group).
斂聚也。从辵求聲。《虞書》曰：“㫄逑孱功。”又曰：“怨匹曰逑。”
As per 余# (stretch) + 辵 movement → long *road/way* (one that stretches far) → *distance*; *counter* (for routes).
In effect, a variant form of 徑 (*path*; *diameter*; *direct*), replacing 彳 with 辵 (both elements indicating "movement"). 逕 also bears the borrowed meaning *at once*.
As per 狄# (disperse) + 辵 movement → disperse and *keep at a distance* → *far*.
遠也。从辵狄聲。
An abbreviated form# of 豎 (stand) (n.) + 辵 movement → shuffle in place (compare 躕) → *stay*; *remain*; *stop*.
止也。从辵豆聲。
辵 movement + 言# words → meet, then speak. *This* and *crawl* are borrowed meanings.

As per 甬# (run through) + 辵 movement → run/*pass through*. The many extended meanings include *go back and forth* (to work, school etc.); *commute*; *attend a school*; *frequent* (a particular place); *run between two points*; *street*; *avenue*; *traffic*; *go/run through*; *pass*; *pierce*; *penetrate*; *drainage*; *ventilation* and *conduct*. Also, *cook/heat up food* (← pass food through heat); *look through/over* (← run the eyes over); *do continuously* (← run through); *pass* (a bill); *maintain* (a position) (← be consistent from start to finish ← run through); *understanding* (← know a subject from start to finish ← run through) → *be reasonable/logical*; *reputation*; *be well known* (← reputation for understanding). Further, *as expected* and *in accordance with* (← run in accordance with expectations), *be known as by* and *be regarded as* (← reputation), *accept/admit* (← admit the logic of an argument), *degree* (← degree of completeness ← run from start to finish), and *thus*(ly) (← run in accordance with logic/expectations).
達也。从辵甬聲。
As per 狂# (run wild) + 辵 movement → *roam*; *ramble*; *wander*. Compare 徨.
As per 折# (cut) + 辵 movement → *take one's leave* in a cutting/decisive manner → *pass away*; *die*.
往也。从辵折聲。讀若誓。
As per 呈# (extend) + 辵 movement → show off one's prowess in carrying out an extensive undertaking → *strong*; *brawny*; *robust* (← strong enough to carry out an undertaking successfully).
通也。从辵呈聲。楚謂疾行爲逞。《春秋傳》曰：“何所不逞欲。”

As per 束# (compact) + 辵 movement → time compacted/compressed in rushing about (compare 走 and 怱) → *fast*; *quick*; *speedy* → *prompt*; *immediately*; *speed*. For the connection between compaction/compression and running, also compare 趨.
疾也。从辵束聲。
As per 告# (bend) + 辵 movement/action indicator → *build/make* by bending objects → *make/cook up*; *invent*.
就也。从辵告聲。譚長說：造，上士也。
As per 夋# as described in 俊 (stand erect) + 辵 movement → *draw/step back* in increments (maintaining an erect posture) → *retreat*.
復也。从辵夋聲。
夆# meet + 辵 movement (for emphasis/clarification) → *meet*.
遇也。从辵，峯省聲。

車 here an abbreviated form# of 陣 (military vehicles in tight rows) + 辵 movement → rows of military vehicles on the move → *be/put in a row*; *be lined up*; *range*; *arrange*; *link* → *be involved*; *be accompanied/taken*; *companion*; *regiment* → *attend* (← be one of many attendees).
員連也。从辵从車。
迹逪也。从辵昔聲。
并# align + 辵 movement → *split* an object, causing pieces to align → *split open*; *scatter* → *spurt*; *gush out*. Also, by further extension, *flee*.
As per 官# (wrap about/enclose) + 辵 movement → wrap/enclose oneself in a protective environment, evading danger → *evade*; *avoid*; *flee*.
逃也。从辵官聲。
隶# (seize) + 辵 movement → *chase* and seize/*capture* → *reach*.
唐逮，及也。从辵隶聲。
行謹逯逯也。从辵录聲。
周# circulate + 辵 movement → *circulate*, completing one cycle (compare 期 and 季) → *week*.
隹 here an abbreviated form# of 隼 (swift bird) + 辵 movement → birds advancing in swift flight and tight formation (compare 迅) → *advance* → *offer*; *promotion*.
登也。从辵，閵省聲。
As per 卓# (rise above) + 辵 movement → move/leap upward a *great distance*. Compare 踔.
遠也。从辵卓聲。一曰蹇也。讀若棹苕之棹。

坴 as described in 陸 (stretch) → 辵 movement → (major) *crossroads* (that stretch away at length). Compare 衢. The pronunciation of the character is influenced by an early variant form with the phonosemantic element 匱.
As per 委# (hang low) + 辵 movement → *winding* or *twisted* motion of a pendent object.
逶迆，衺去之皃。从辵委聲。
As per 兔#/兎 rabbit (fast-moving) + 辵 movement → *be fast* and elusive → *stray*; *deviate* → *be missing*. The present form deletes one stroke from 兔. There is no etymological connection with 免.
失也。从辵、兔。兔謾訑善逃也。

As per 畐# as described in 副 (abundance) + 辵 movement → large number of fighters approaching/drawing near to surround an enemy → *approach*/*draw near* → *press upon* (in drawing near) → *pursue*; *compel*. 逼 and 偪 are effectively variant forms of each other. Compare also 匐.
近也。从辵畐聲。
兪# remove + 辵 movement → pass/cross over (← remove oneself to a different location) → *exceed* → *even more/further*. Compare 踰.
𨒋進也。从辵俞聲。《周書》曰：“無敢昬逾。”
As per 盾# (follow behind a shield) + 辵 movement → follow a sheltering object in fleeing/escaping → *flee*; *escape*; *evade*; *avoid*; *hide*.
遷也。一曰逃也。从辵盾聲。

The relevant seal inscription form of the right-hand element# is 豕 pig/boar + 八 split right and left → pig/boar being butchered. 遂 adds 辵 movement → drag a heavy object such as a pig/boar along a winding course all the way to its destination (compare 水) → *carry through* → *accomplish*; *attain*; *achieve*; *wind up* (making/doing). In derivative characters, 遂 also appears in the form seen for example in 隧 and 燧.
亾也。从辵㒸聲。
As per 耑# (neatly aligned) + 辵 movement → *quick* back and forth movements (of equal distance) → *go back and forth*; *hurry*.
往來𢿙也。从辵耑聲。《易》曰：“㠯事遄往。”
As per 禺# (curve) + 辵 movement → two persons who form a pair as they *meet* at a bend in a road.
逢也。从辵禺聲。
As per 貞# (inspect) + 辵 movement → *search for* in inspecting. In Japan, 遉 also bears the meanings *as might be expected* and *for all that*.

As per 斿# (float) + 辵 movement → *roam*/*wander* as if floating about → *move about freely* → *recreation*; *play*; *nomadism*; *be at ease*. Extended meanings include *game*; *pastime*; *diversion*; *amusement*; *pleasure*; *enjoyment*; *have fun*; *take a vacation*; *be idle*; *be out of use* and *leave free/idle*. Also, *deign to* (← undertake at one's pleasure).

As per 軍# (circularity) + 辵 movement → *move about in a circle* (compare 還) → *transport*; *carry*; *convey* → (make) *progress*; *manage/carry out* (an undertaking). *Fate* comes from the idea of the circulation of good and evil in the course of one's life; compare 業.
迻徙也。从辵軍聲。
相遇驚也。从辵从㖾，㖾亦聲。
As per 扁# (spread, but remain in contact) + 辵 movement → journey far, but remain in contact → *widespread*. Also, *general* (compare 凡).

咼# (variant of 冎 round or rounded cavity) + 辵 movement/action indicator → *passage* through a cavity → *passing time* → *elapse*; *exceed*; *go past* (← surplus energy) → *be over* (← past); *err*; *mistake*; *fault* (← go/take too far).
度也。从辵咼聲。
As per 曷# (cut off) + 辵 movement → cut off movement → *stop*; *suppress*; *restrain*.
微止也。从辵曷聲。讀若桑蟲之蝎。
As per 叚# (overlay) + 辵 movement → set people/things at a progressively greater distance from each other → *be separated by a great distance*; *far*.
遠也。从辵叚聲。
As per 皇# (extend) + 辵 movement → *be at great leisure* to wander extensively. *Be anxious* is a borrowed meaning via 惶.
急也。从辵皇聲。或从彳。
首# (run through) + 辵 movement → *path*, *road* or *street* running through a settlement → *way*; *highway*.
所行道也。从辵从𩠐。一達謂之道。

Originally, 辵 movement + an element combining 大 great and 羊 sheep → procession of a great flock of sheep → *proceed smoothly*; *arrive at*; *reach* → *achieve*; *be in use*; *notice*; *deliver*; *skillful*. Suffix meaning a *plural number of humans* is a borrowed meaning.
行不相遇也。从辵羍聲。《詩》曰：“挑兮達兮。”
As per 韋# (go around) + 辵 movement → two patrols crossing while circling in opposite directions → *differ* (← cross) → *be mistaken*; *alter*; *sprain* (a wrist/ankle); *break a promise*.
離也。从辵韋聲。
南 south (→ place filled with bright sunshine) + 辵 movement/action indicator → *splendid* (appearance/character) → *expression conveying praise*.
As per 冓# (symmetry) + 辵 movement → *meet* (by approaching from opposite directions). *Hold an audience* is a borrowed meaning.
遇也。从辵冓聲。
孫# descendant; grandchild + 辵 movement/action indicator → *humble oneself*; *be modest*; *yielding*; *concede* (← behavior considered proper for young people with respect to their elders).
遁也。从辵孫聲。
䢔也。从辵眔聲。

虒# is 虎 tiger + 厂 cliff/shape indicator → mythical animal conceived of as crawling on its belly, in sequential motion, one leg at a time. 遞 adds 辵 movement/action indicator → move sequentially, in *relay* or stages → *stage*.
更易也。从辵虒聲。
As per 袁# (wrap about/enclose) + 辵 movement → move a great *distance* within enclosed territory (compare 運, 還, and 逭) → *distant*; *far*.
遼也。从辵袁聲。
As per 朔# (conjunction of beginning and end points) + 辵 movement → *return to the source*; *retrace the past*. Also, *move upstream*.

The relevant oracle bone form of the right-hand element# combines 㠯 as described in 官 (wrapped objects) + a pair of hands → pass/send a wrapped object to someone else. 遣 is the right-hand element# + 辵 movement (for emphasis/clarification) → *send/dispatch* → *expend*; *spend*; *present*. Also, *manipulate* (← manipulate in sending/dispatching). Also, *consume* (← consume what is sent one).
縱也。从辵𠳋聲。
As per 䍃# as described in 搖 (waver) + 辵 movement → *wander* at length → *distant*; *far away*. Note a variant form 遙.
逍遥也。又，遠也。从辵䍃聲。
習也。从辵貫聲。
As per 敖# (spread/roam without restraint) + 辵 movement → unfettered rambling/traveling → *enjoy oneself at will*.
As per 啇# (variant of 啻) (unify) + 辵 movement → form a single unit *appropriate* to circumstances → *suitable*; *fit neatly*; *match* → *move*.
之也。从辵啻聲。適，宋魯語。
As per 曹# (array) + 辵 movement → set off and *meet* a variety of people → *encounter*; *subject/be subject to*.
遇也。从辵曹聲。一曰邐行。
As per 庶# (pile) + 辵 movement → pile objects in screening/cutting off → *obstruct*; *block*; *cut off* → *interrupt*.
遏也。从辵庶聲。
逃也。从辵从豚。
去也。从辵帶聲。
連遱也。从辵婁聲。
As per 犀# (slow) + 辵 movement → *slow* movement → *late*; *delay*; *defer*; *lag*; *wait patiently* → *at length/last* (← wait).
徐行也。从辵犀聲。《詩》曰：“行道遲遲。”

As per 粦# as described in 隣 (repeated series) + 辵 movement (→ action indicator) → *align* a number of objects → *select* (← select from among aligned items; compare 柬). Also, *hesitate* (← hesitate in selecting from among numerous items).
行難也。从辵㷠聲。《易》曰：“以往䢯。”
As per 尊# (settle) + 辵 movement → settle a matter → *follow*; *comply with*; *obey*.
循也。从辵尊聲。
As per 堯# (arch/rise high) + 辵 movement → *coil/twine about* a tall object → *circulate*; *surround*. Compare 繞.

The relevant seal inscription form of the right-hand element# is combines 1) two pairs of hands about a skull with openings at top (the fontanels described in the entries for 兒 and 思) and 2) a kneeling figure + 廾 (pair of hands) → soul departing the body (through the head) as a result of magical or ascetic practices. 遷 adds 辵 movement → depart and *transfer*/*shift* one's location → *change*.
登也。从辵𠨧聲。
As per 巽# (arrange in formation) + 辵 movement (→ action indicator) (for emphasis/clarification) → arrange prior to making a selection → *select*; *choose*.
遣也。从辵、巽，巽遣之；巽亦聲。一曰選，擇也。

As per 矞# (circular) + 辵 movement → *follow* a circular course → *circle about*. Also, *avoid* (← follow others in making an escape). Compare 遁, where the idea is that of following a sheltering object in fleeing/escaping.
回避也。从辵矞聲。
貴# valuable goods + 辵 movement → movement of valuable goods in being bequeathed → *bequeath*; *leave behind* → *leave*. *Send* is a borrowed meaning.
亾也。从辵䝿聲。
As per 尞# as described in 僚 (circular continuum) + 辵 movement → move to a *distant* point along a circular course.
遠也。从辵尞聲。
As per 豦# as described in 劇 (fierce) + 辵 movement/action indicator → sudden, fierce activity → *sudden(ly)*. *Fear* is a borrowed meaning (compare 虞).
傳也。一曰窘也。从辵豦聲。
As per 辟# (spread) + 辵 movement → spread in evasive movement → *evade*; *avoid*; *avert* → *shun*; *remain aloof*; *shirk*.
回也。从辵辟聲。
As per 敫# as described in 激 (collide and scatter) + 辵 movement → collide with and scatter enemies (compare 徼) → *await*; *meet*; *confront*.

As per 萬# (virulent → vigorous) + 辵 movement → pass over vigorously (such as in working a bladed implement over a whetstone; compare 礪) → *pass by* → *pass out of sight*; *exceed*. Also, *excel* (← exceed others).
遠行也。从辵，蠆省聲。
As per 解# (remove a protective element) + 辵 movement (→ action indicator) → remove a barrier/partition and make an unexpected find → *chance/unexpected encounter*.
邂逅，不期而遇也。从辵解聲。
遂 here an abbreviated form# of 隧 underground passage + 穴 hole → follow a hole or underground passage to its depths → *deep* → *profound*. Compare 窕.
深遠也。从穴遂聲。
As per 睘# as described in 環 (circular) + 辵 movement → *circulate* (compare 運) and *return* → *circle*; *look back*. For the meaning "look back," compare 眷.
復也。从辵瞏聲。
As per 亶# (long and flat) + 辵 movement → *falter*, stumble and stretch flat on the ground → *come to a halt*.
As per 爾# (adhere) + 辵 movement → draw *near* → *proximate* → *familiar*.
近也。从辵爾聲。
As per 貌# (obscure) + 辵 movement → move *far* to an obscure, *distant* point. Also, *be contemptuous of* (← regard as having barely visible merit; compare 藐).

The lower part of 臱 is 方 (spread) + 穴 hole → separate holes that are in close proximity. The addition of 自 (nose) specifies the apertures of a nose, the latter an object forming a border between the two sides of a face. 邊 is as per 臱# (border) + 辵 movement → move to a *border*/*boundary* → *vicinity*; *end*; *edge* → *side* (of a polygon).
搚也。从辵巤聲。
As per 黎# (plow) + 辵 movement → *walk slowly* in plowing.
徐也。从辵黎聲。
高平之野，人所登。从辵、备、录。闕。
行邎徑也。从辵䌛聲。
羅# net + 辵 movement → *go about* on *patrol*, forming a net.
巡也。从辵羅聲。
An abbreviated form# of 驪 (neatly aligned) + 辵 movement → *move in alignment*.
行邐邐也。从辵麗聲。

巴 here a variant of 丮# (kneeling figure with arms extended) + 囗 circular enclosure → subjects pressed into an enclosed space, who kneel and extend their arms in obeisance → *village*; *settlement*; *town*. Confusingly, when used as an element in a dual-element character, 邑 is written as 阝, the same simplification as employed for 阜 piled earth. The difference is that 邑 appears on the right (examples: 邦, 邸, or 郊) while 阜 appears on the left (examples: 防, 限, or 陷).
國也。从囗；先王之制，尊卑有大小，从卪。凡邑之屬皆从邑。
南陽縣。从邑己聲。
巛# a variant of 川 river + 邑 village/settlement → moat (compare 隍) encircling a settlement → moated *village*.
四方有水，自邕城池者。从川从邑。
地名。从邑山聲。
國也，今屬臨淮。从邑干聲。一曰邗本屬吳。
周武王子所封。在河内野王是也。从邑于聲。又讀若區。
河南洛陽北亡山上邑。从邑亡聲。
邛地。在濟陰縣。从邑工聲。
琅邪縣。一名純德。从邑夫聲。
潁川縣。从邑亢聲。
周太王國。在右扶風美陽。从邑分聲。
什邡，廣漢縣。从邑方聲。

The left-hand element# is a variant of 冄 as described in 冉 (supple). 那 adds 邑 (village/settlement), but the original form of the character had a different element than 邑. The identity of this original form and the original meaning of the character are now obscure, although the meaning was likely to have been connected with the concept "supple" as this concept is active in derivative characters such as 娜, 挪 and 梛. *How*, *which*, *what*, and *that* are all borrowed meanings. 那 is used in transliterations of terms such as 刹那 (Sanskrit: ksana), an instant.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is as per 丰# (cone-shaped, fruit-bearing ears of grain) + 田 field. A bronzeware inscription form replaces 田 with 邑 village/settlement → platform built upon a cone-shaped mound of earth that proclaims (to the gods) the ownership of a particular area of land (compare 封) → *country* → *Japan*.
國也。从邑丰聲。
鄭邑也。从邑元聲。
地名。从邑屯聲。
地名。从邑火聲。
As per 牙# (mesh; cross) + 邑 village/settlement → a crossroads settlement → *evil* (← superstitious association of crossroads with misfortune) → *wrong*; *illness*.
琅邪郡。从邑牙聲。
地名。从邑句聲。
左馮翊高陵。从邑由聲。
趙邯鄲縣。从邑甘聲。
炎帝之後，姜姓所封，周棄外家國。从邑台聲。右扶風斄縣是也。《詩》曰：“有邰家室。”
丘# hill + 邑 village/settlement → settlement on a *hill*.
地名。从邑丘聲。
晉邑也。从邑必聲。《春秋傳》曰：“晋楚戰于邲。”
奚仲之後，湯左相仲虺所封國。在魯辥縣。从邑丕聲。
宋下邑。从邑丙聲。
晉邑也。从邑召聲。
故商邑。自河内朝歌以北是也。从邑北聲。
氐# foundation + 邑 village/settlement → *residence* of an official or important figure (likened to the foundation of a community) → *mansion*.
屬國舍。从邑氐聲。
河東聞喜鄉。从邑匡聲。
隴西上邽也。从邑圭聲。
江夏縣。从邑朱聲。
附庸國。在東平亢父邿亭。从邑寺聲。《春秋傳》曰：“取邿。”
As per 有# (extend) + 邑 village/settlement → extensive, *prosperous* settlement (compare 旺) → *fragrant* (← fragrance of prosperity/success).
右扶風郁夷也。从邑有聲。
陳畱鄉。从邑亥聲。
左馮翊郃陽縣。从邑合聲。《詩》曰：“在郃之陽。”
北地郁郅縣。从邑至聲。
周武王子所封國，在晉地。从邑旬聲。讀若泓。
東平無鹽鄉。从邑后聲。
周公子所封，地近河内懷。从邑幵聲。
As per 交# (twist/cross) + 邑 village/settlement → *suburb* (← residential area sited close to a town, allowing for easy crossing back and forth in commuting).
距國百里爲郊。从邑交聲。
汝南邵陵里。从邑自聲。讀若奚。

As per 良# (flowing stream) + 邑 village/settlement → village/settlement adjacent to a pure, flowing stream. Via "pure," 郎 came to indicate a "clean/pure young man," next became a term by which wives addressed their husbands, and finally developed into a euphemism for a male → *man*.
魯亭也。从邑良聲。
鄭地。从邑延聲。
魯孟氏邑。从邑成聲。
弘農縣庾地。从邑豆聲。
周邑也。在河内。从邑希聲。
汝南上蔡亭。从邑甫聲。
東海縣。故紀矦之邑也。从邑吾聲。
As per 孚# (envelop/enclose) + 邑 village/settlement → *enclosure* (about a city/castle); *city wall*.
郭也。从邑孚聲。
周文王子所封國。从邑告聲。
右扶風鄠、盩厔鄉。从邑赤聲。
潁川縣。从邑夾聲。
琅邪莒邑。从邑更聲。《春秋傳》曰：“取郠。”
As per 君# (group) + 邑 village/settlement → administrative group → *district*; *county* → *division of an administrative unit*.
周制：天子地方千里，分爲百縣，縣有四郡。故《春秋傳》曰“上大夫受郡”是也。至秦初置三十六郡，以監其縣。从邑君聲。
故楚都。在南郡江陵北十里。从邑呈聲。
郣海地。从邑孛聲。一曰地之起者曰郣。
谷# valley + 邑 village/settlement → valley settlement. Later, the term came to refer to a *depression* and a proper name, as well as in Chinese medicine to denote the space between bone and muscle.
晉大夫叔虎邑也。从邑谷聲。

As per 咅# (spread) + 邑 village/settlement → spread over *part* of a settlement → *section*; *group*. Also, (via "a part"), *counter* (for books/papers) and *radical/classifier* for a Han/Chinese character.
天水狄部。从邑咅聲。
新郪，汝南縣。从邑妻聲。
蜀縣也。从邑卑聲。

As per 享 (enclosure) + 邑 village/settlement → *enclosure* about a village/settlement → *quarters*; *red-light district*. The phonetic evidence suggests that the 享 element in 郭 has replaced a graphically similar element indicating a circular enclosure; compare 或.
齊之郭氏虚。善善不能進，惡惡不能退，是以亡國也。从邑𩫏聲。
東海縣。帝少昊之後所封。从邑炎聲。
魯下邑。孔子之鄉。从邑取聲。
地名。从邑并聲。
齊地。从邑兒聲。《春秋傳》曰：“齊高厚定郳田。”
桂陽縣。从邑林聲。
邑 village/settlement + 垂# (boundary marker) → distant, frontier settlement → *mail* (← distant relay points for mail). The pronunciation of 郵 has been influenced by 華.
境上行書舍。从邑、垂。垂，邊也。
蔡邑也。从邑狊聲。《春秋傳》曰：“郹陽封人之女奔之。”
As per 者# (pile) + 邑 village/settlement → *metropolis* or *capital* on a hill (= pile of earth) → *gather*; *assemble*; *rule* (many people); *all*; *administrative division*.
有先君之舊宗廟曰都。从邑者聲。周禮：距國五百里爲都。
潁川縣。从邑匽聲。
右扶風縣。从邑眉聲。
